header: This prepares the announcements that already exist for the search bar (their text and their PDFs), the way a new publish does (src/lib/announcements/searchIndex/). It is for announcements published before the search index existed, or whose preparation failed (the manager's "Index again" does one at a time). npx tsx --env-file=.env.local --tsconfig tsconfig.json scripts/index-announcements.ts lists what WOULD be done, writes nothing npx tsx --env-file=.env.local --tsconfig tsconfig.json scripts/index-announcements.ts --apply does it ... --only 12,15 only these announcement ids ... --failed only those whose text or PDF is not "ready" yet I made it write only the index tables (derived data: passages, page pictures, state) and the announcements' own vectors. It never changes an announcement's title, text, PDF or date. Gemini reads only the pages of a PDF that have no usable text of their own, and makes the vectors.
